name: How do I know if I need a new roof?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if I need a new roof?

acceptedAnswer.text: Several signs indicate it's time for a new roof. Look for missing, cracked, or curled shingles. Granules from shingles accumulating in gutters are another warning. If your roof is over 20-25 years old, or if you notice sagging spots, leaks, or daylight coming through your attic, these are strong indicators that replacement is necessary. A professional inspection can confirm the extent of damage and recommend the best course of action.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for missing/damaged shingles, granules in gutters, or a roof over 20-25 years old. Leaks or sagging are also key indicators.
